stories.headline: Break-in suspects crashed stolen SUV into Whitby game store: police
stories.summary: Durham Regional Police investigators say suspects in a Whitby break-and-enter used a stolen SUV to crash their way into a game store. Officers responded a break-and-enter call at We Got Gamez, located at 1910 Dundas Street East, on Thursday morning at around 2:55 a.m.

stories.headline: Andy Taylor, guitarist of new wave icons Duran Duran, dies at 65
stories.summary: Andy Taylor, the original guitarist of the 1980s English new wave band Duran Duran, whose huge pop hits included "Hungry Like the Wolf," "The Reflex" and "Rio" and were inextricably linked to the launch of MTV, has died. He was 65.
